person_portrait.label: Real Person Portrait
person_portrait.rules: Must show the real person clearly recognizable (face + upper body). NO statues, waxworks, graves, plaques, comic drawings, wrong namesake/homonym people, blurry distant crowd shots, or huge event banners spelling their name behind them.

movie_or_tv.label: Movie or TV Show Scene
movie_or_tv.rules: Must be an iconic recognizable film/TV scene, main protagonist character, iconic prop, or cast still. MUST REJECT movie posters, DVD covers, title cards, giant title logos, generic unrelated objects (like marshmallows or stock buildings), programming screensavers, or blurry 220px thumbnails.

videogame_scene.label: Video Game Gameplay / Scene
videogame_scene.rules: Must show recognizable in-game gameplay, protagonist, or iconic setting. MUST REJECT title screens, box art, Steam header capsules with the game title logo, blank menus, tiny sprites, or generic real-world photos.

animation_character.label: Animated / Superhero Character
animation_character.rules: Must cleanly show the iconic animated/comic character or superhero in recognizable outfit/design. MUST REJECT comic book covers with titles, toys/action figures in boxes, amateur cosplay unless iconic studio still, tattoos, or text title cards.

food_dish.label: Food, Dish, Ingredient or Drink
food_dish.rules: Appetizing, sharp, well-lit close-up of the actual dish, ingredient, cheese, fruit, pastry, or drink served cleanly. NO supermarket packaging with huge brand/product text, NO restaurant menus or signs naming the dish, NO tiny distant table plates.

product_or_object.label: Everyday Object, Brand Item, Vehicle or Instrument
product_or_object.rules: Clean, unmistakable focal view of the object, snack, vehicle, clothing, musical/scientific tool, or board game pieces in use. MUST REJECT packaging/labels/badges where the exact answer word or brand logo text is prominently readable, empty boxes, tiny icons padded with huge white borders, or diagrams with text labels.

animal_nature.label: Living Animal in Focus
animal_nature.rules: Sharp, living animal clearly visible in natural habitat or close-up portrait. MUST REJECT antique drawings/lithographs, skeletons, skulls, fossils, dead museum specimens in jars, pinned insects with paper taxonomy labels, or tiny blurry dots in wide landscape.

landmark_or_nature.label: Landmark, Architecture, City or Natural Wonder
landmark_or_nature.rules: Iconic unmistakable view of the monument, bridge, skyline, wonder, nebula/planet, gem, or flower/tree. MUST REJECT locator maps, historical floor plans, distant unrecognizable panoramas, or tourist signs displaying the monument name.

artwork_or_myth.label: Art Masterpiece, Mythology or Mask
artwork_or_myth.rules: Clean faithful reproduction of the artwork, sculpture, mythological figure depiction, or mask without museum wall plaques naming the piece or heavy skewed tourist glares.

sport_action.label: Sport Discipline in Action
sport_action.rules: Dynamic, immediately clear photo of athletes actively performing the exact sport. NO rulebook diagrams, pictograms, empty stadiums, or scoreboard banners naming the sport.

internet_meme.label: Viral Meme, Trend or Gen-Z Cultural Icon
internet_meme.rules: Must be the unmistakable viral meme template, object, or cultural phenomenon. REJECT if giant overlaid caption text contains the exact answer name or unrelated random stock photos.

flag_or_sprite.label: Flag or Official Creature Artwork
flag_or_sprite.rules: Clean official flag or official creature illustration with zero text labels or country/creature name printed on it.
